flows: Navigate to http://127.0.0.1:3005/product/1 then Click 'Add to Cart', then in the cart click 'Proceed to Checkout', and verify that 'Secure Checkout' is displayed.

remark: click: Clicking Update button for cart item quantity
wait: Waiting after confirming checkout is unavailable

summary:
The agent took an extra Update action on the cart item before trying to check out. That action put this test run into the displayed disabled-checkout state, so the required checkout step could not be completed.
Remove the cart-quantity update from this scenario. After Add to Cart opens the cart, click Proceed to Checkout and then check for Secure Checkout.
one_liner: The run updated the cart even though the requested flow only required adding the item and proceeding to checkout.
reason: Checkout remains disabled with an explicit defect error after updating the cart quantity.

verdict.root_cause: The agent took an extra Update action on the cart item before trying to check out. That action put this test run into the displayed disabled-checkout state, so the required checkout step could not be completed.
verdict.agent_fault_assessment: The agent caused this outcome by clicking the cart item's Update button at step 0-3, an action not included in the objective. The add-to-cart flow had completed successfully and the cart contained the item; the agent should have selected Proceed to Checkout directly instead of altering the cart state.
